parallel_writer.guard: exact id, tenant, prior status, tool, parent lineage, code and prior execution error
parallel_writer.transaction: dedicated owned session for snapshot/result CAS/commit; caller session is never committed or rolled back by the sandbox

caller_contract.unflushed_orm_work: left untouched; owned CAS may run; caller commits its own edit
caller_contract.flushed_caller_work: detected by public Session after_flush marker; returns bounded skipped/deferred caller_transaction_pending before dispatch; caller transaction preserved
caller_contract.clean_read_transaction: released only after the authoritative snapshot read; releases no writes
caller_contract.caller_identity_map: expired after an owned commit only when the caller is clean and has no pending/flushed work
caller_contract.never: commit, rollback or discard unrelated caller work; autoflush the caller into the result CAS

review_contract.pre_dispatch: approved/rejected committed before invocation -> zero sandbox calls
review_contract.during_worker: review wins the result CAS; sandbox is skipped; review preserved
review_contract.lineage_code_error: changed material during worker -> zero-row CAS, skipped, peer preserved

result_states.verified: owned CAS matched; passed/failed committed on the owned session
result_states.skipped: review/status/material changed, missing target or unsafe flushed caller transaction; caller/peer state preserved
result_states.deferred: caller_transaction_pending; caller must commit or roll back its own work and retry

not_covered: physical cancellation of an in-flight worker
